external.sales_source_name: Sensor Tower via BBC / The Business Standard

events.title: Trailer 1
events.note: The first trailer came out a day early after it leaked online. 93 million YouTube views in 24 hours, a record.

events.title: Release date kept (fall 2025)
events.note: In its quarterly results, Take-Two said GTA VI was still on track for fall 2025.

events.title: Delay #1 (to May 2026)
events.note: Rockstar moved the release from fall 2025 to 26 May 2026.

events.title: Trailer 2
events.note: The second trailer: 475 million views in 24 hours across all platforms, a new record.

events.title: Delay #2 (to Nov 2026)
events.note: Moved again, to 19 November 2026. Roughly $3 billion was wiped off Take-Two's value.

events.title: Google AI scare (not GTA)
events.note: Not GTA news: a new Google AI tool scared investors in all video game companies. Shown for comparison: a big fall with no GTA hype at all.

events.title: Pre-orders open
events.note: Fans could finally order the game: $79.99 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

events.title: Third trailer ("An Extended Look")
events.note: A long first look at gameplay, shown on Netflix first and then YouTube.

events.title: Pre-orders beat expectations
events.note: Take-Two said GTA VI pre-orders were ahead of expectations, even though other results were weaker.

events.title: Reviews: 99/100
events.note: Reviews came out the day before launch: 99 out of 100, one of the best scores ever.

events.title: Launch day
events.note: GTA VI went on sale. Investors who bought on the hype took their profits.
